import { Injectable, Module } from '@nestjs/common';
import { BullModule, InjectQueue, Processor, WorkerHost } from '@nestjs/bullmq';
import { Job, Queue } from 'bullmq';

declare function runtimeQueueName(): string;

@Injectable()
class DynamicQueueProducer {
  constructor(
    @InjectQueue(runtimeQueueName())
    private readonly queue: Queue<unknown, unknown, string>,
  ) {}

  // D0_CASE:bullmq-dynamic-queue
  async enqueue(): Promise<void> {
    await this.queue.add('known-job', {});
  }
}

@Injectable()
class DynamicJobProducer {
  constructor(
    @InjectQueue('reports')
    private readonly queue: Queue<unknown, unknown, string>,
  ) {}

  // D0_CASE:bullmq-dynamic-job
  async enqueue(jobName: string): Promise<void> {
    await this.queue.add(jobName, {});
  }
}

class LocalQueue {
  add(_name: string, _data: unknown): Promise<unknown> {
    return Promise.resolve(undefined);
  }
}

@Injectable()
class AmbiguousQueueProducer {
  constructor(
    @InjectQueue('ambiguous')
    private readonly queue: Queue<unknown, unknown, string> | LocalQueue,
  ) {}

  // D0_CASE:bullmq-ambiguous-receiver
  async enqueue(): Promise<void> {
    await this.queue.add('job', {});
  }
}

namespace LocalBullMq {
  export function Processor(_name: string): ClassDecorator {
    return () => undefined;
  }

  export abstract class WorkerHost {
    abstract process(job: { readonly name: string }): Promise<unknown>;
  }
}

// D0_CASE:bullmq-local-lookalike
@LocalBullMq.Processor('reports')
class LookalikeProcessor extends LocalBullMq.WorkerHost {
  async process(_job: { readonly name: string }): Promise<void> {}
}

// D0_CASE:bullmq-orphan-processor
@Processor('orphan')
class OrphanProcessor extends WorkerHost {
  async process(_job: Job<unknown, unknown, string>): Promise<void> {}
}

@Injectable()
class DuplicateProducer {
  constructor(
    @InjectQueue('duplicate')
    private readonly queue: Queue<unknown, unknown, string>,
  ) {}

  // D0_CASE:bullmq-duplicate-processors
  async enqueue(): Promise<void> {
    await this.queue.add('duplicate-job', {});
  }
}

@Processor('duplicate')
class FirstDuplicateProcessor extends WorkerHost {
  async process(_job: Job<unknown, unknown, string>): Promise<void> {}
}

@Processor('duplicate')
class SecondDuplicateProcessor extends WorkerHost {
  async process(_job: Job<unknown, unknown, string>): Promise<void> {}
}

@Module({
  imports: [
    BullModule.forRoot({}),
    BullModule.registerQueue({ name: 'reports' }, { name: 'ambiguous' }, { name: 'duplicate' }),
  ],
  providers: [
    DynamicQueueProducer,
    DynamicJobProducer,
    AmbiguousQueueProducer,
    DuplicateProducer,
    FirstDuplicateProcessor,
    SecondDuplicateProcessor,
  ],
})
class NegativeBullMqModule {}

const __D0_EXECUTION_SENTINEL__ = (() => {
  throw new Error('D0 BullMQ fixture must never execute: negatives');
})();
void __D0_EXECUTION_SENTINEL__;
